world_news_real.description: Dr Vincent Brown, formerly Dr Vincent Bajinya, 65, will appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Tuesday charged with seven offences.

world_news_real.description: The country's meteorological agency had warned of an "imminent threat to life," but this has now been downgraded in most areas.

world_news_real.title: Xhaka under investigation over Covid-19 certificate

world_news_real.description: A report says the attacks, of which there have been at least 68, were not self-defence.
